# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

My name’s Chen Silva, zip code 46281. I don’t remember which email I used on the order, sorry, I’ve got too many.

If you can’t put the refund back on the credit card, then honestly I’d rather just return everything on that order and have it refunded to a gift card instead.
chen_silva_7485
